title: observability: add token/KV metrics + tracing dashboard, refine alerts for cost/latency breakdowns
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Token-level cost and latency regressions continue to be a leading contributor to customer incidents (see ENG-4921). Teams need a single-pane view that correlates per-token cost, KV cache hit/miss, per-request latency, and span/tracing metadata so we can quickly triage quality vs cost regressions. This PR introduces a combined token/KV metrics + tracing Grafana dashboard, refines existing alerting rules to reduce noise while preserving SLO guardrails, and adds instrumentation to capture KV cache hit breakdowns at the request/token granularity. Changes are non-breaking for downstream consumers but enable more actionable alerts and runbook links.
commits:
1) add: token_kv_cost_latency dashboard UI json (dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.json)
2) feat: emit observability.kv.cache.{hit,miss} and observability.token.cost metrics from metrics_collector (serving/metrics/kv_metrics_collector.py)
3) chore: update alert rules and add escalation links (observability/alerts/token_kv_alerts.yml)
4) test: unit + e2e for kv metrics export and dashboard smoke test
review_comments:
Diego: Can we reduce the alert sensitivity for the token-cost spike to avoid noisy pager on short-lived incidents? Suggested: require 5m sustained and a % increase over 95th baseline.
Maya: Updated rules to use 5m window + 50% relative increase over P95 baseline; added runbook pointer.
Priya: Please add a smoke test that loads the dashboard and validates panels render in CI (Grafana image compare flaky historically).
Maya: Added observability-smoke CI job and a lightweight panel health check that asserts expected metric names are present.
Evan: Ensure we add span_id and model_version tags to tracing spans so we can join traces to token metrics; also add a small note to the runbook about joining traces.
Maya: Added span enrichment in span_enrichment.py; updated runbook and docs.
Review outcome: Approvals from Diego and Priya after CI green; small follow-up requested to track dashboard rendering flakiness (tracked in ENG-5018).
release_notes:
- Added token-level / KV-cache Grafana dashboard for cost & latency correlation.
- Emitted new metrics: observability.kv.cache.hit, observability.kv.cache.miss, observability.token.cost.
- Refined alerting rules to a 5m sustained window + relative increase heuristic to reduce noise.
- Added CI smoke job to validate dashboard panel health.
- Updated runbook with trace join instructions (span_id + model_version).
